definitions.explanation: A formal ceremony marking the end of an event, conference, festival, or competition. Commonly associated with the Olympics, sports events, and academic gatherings.

examples.japanese: ⟦オリンピック→オリンピック：09899_orinpikku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{閉会式|へいかいしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I watched the Olympic closing ceremony.

examples.japanese: {閉会式|へいかいしき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行進|こうしん}→行進：22196_koushin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The athletes marched during the closing ceremony.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{閉会式|へいかいしき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{開催地|かいさいち}→開催地：18266_kaisaichi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}される→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{恒例|こうれい}→恒例：12597_kourei⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: It has become customary for the host city for the following year to be announced at the closing ceremony of the competition.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{閉会|へいかい}→閉会：23962_heikai⟧ (closing, adjournment) and {式|しき} (ceremony). Most commonly associated with the Olympics and major sporting events, but also used for academic conferences, festivals, and cultural events.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {閉会式|へいかいしき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}する→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧: to attend the closing ceremony
- {閉会式|へいかいしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧: the closing ceremony is held
- ⟦オリンピック→オリンピック：09899_orinpikku⟧{閉会式|へいかいしき}: Olympic closing ceremony
- {閉会式|へいかいしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{演出|えんしゅつ}→演出：04460_enshutsu⟧: production of the closing ceremony

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{開会式|かいかいしき}→開会式：27306_kaikaishiki⟧: opening ceremony — the opposite; the ceremony at the start of an event
- ⟦{閉幕|へいまく}→閉幕：08175_heimaku⟧: closing; final curtain — used for theater, exhibitions, and events ending
- ⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧: graduation ceremony — a specific type of closing ceremony for academic programs
